**Studio design lane (Luis): shared-surface note for G3, no CON-01 source written here.**

- The kit stack (#220–#254, Luis's UI work on the Studio) and #199 meet in four files: `features/conversations/ConversationRows.tsx`, `OpenConversation.tsx`, `conversations.css`, `features/studio/ProjectShell.tsx`, plus the generated contracts (A15 in the stack, A16 here). Whichever lands second resolves; the resolutions are prepared and pushed at `ui/kit-with-con01` (`574766cd` = #199 `d527f385` over #254 `27f310f2`), with the contracts regenerated from both amendments. Lint, typecheck and `contracts:check` clean; 135 of 136 Conversations and kit specs green locally.
- The UI of #199 read against the kit, with measures, is on the PR: https://github.com/davidelaverga/Sophia/pull/199#issuecomment-6115106416 (legacy `.button` at 26 px in the two confirmations; one word for withdraw/remove; the duplicated coverage line; the withdraw press as an acts-row item; the saved-text notice not reachable in the demo fixture).
- Per 05_COORDINATION_AND_OWNERSHIP, edits to those four files and to the contracts stay single-writer: the kit stack will not touch them again until #199's landing order is decided. Tell us which lands first and we take the merge on our side.
